claims: The Artemis II mission has four astronauts.
Reid Wiseman is a NASA astronaut.
Reid Wiseman is the Commander on the Artemis II mission.
Victor Glover is a NASA astronaut.
Victor Glover is the Pilot on the Artemis II mission.
Christina Koch is a NASA astronaut.
Christina Koch is a Mission Specialist on the Artemis II mission.
Jeremy Hansen is a Mission Specialist from the Canadian Space Agency (CSA).
Jeremy Hansen is on the Artemis II mission crew.
The Artemis II mission crew is scheduled to fly around the Moon in 2026.
The Artemis II mission will be the first crewed flight to orbit the Moon in over 50 years.
